why_these_three: Three of the seven listed models, from three different modelling groups (Europe, Italy, Japan); all return data for 1991-2050 at the probe location (EC_Earth3P_HR has 364 null days, i.e. one year, which the parser tolerates).
date_range: docs: data from 1950-01-01 until 2050-01-01 (examples use 2050-12-31; the probe returned data to 2050-12-31)

observed_cost.consequence: about 10 full requests per day on the free tier; national 0.25 degree precompute must be spread over days
